citation.description: Investigation comment in ticket identifies the full code path (transition_ticket -> rebar.transition in-process -> transition_close.close_ticket -> close_precheck._completion_precheck), refutes both hypotheses with code-path evidence. The fix's docstring in transition_close.py line 415-433 also references bug 833e-3827 and explains the root cause.

criteria.criterion: The source `transition_ticket`'s AC precheck reads is identified, and which of the 2 hypotheses holds is stated with evidence from the code path, not inference from the error string.

A regression test fails before the fix and passes after: a close through `rebar.transition` (the entry point MCP `transition_ticket` uses), on a clone whose throttle marker is fresh, observes a description edit pushed from another clone.
For the same ticket at the same moment, the close precheck and a fresh `show_ticket` agree on the AC boxes, for both a satisfied and an unsatisfied ticket (tests 1 and 2).
The forced fetch honors `sync.pull=off`, survives an unreachable origin, and is skipped on a forced close (tests 3-5).
